documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.kzs — 23 endpoints. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the public read API (Java/Spring, built by OnixWeb) that the kzs.si site itself calls. No terms of use were located (unverified), api.kzs.si/robots.txt answers 401 and www.kzs.si/robots.txt 404, so no policy or Crawl-delay is published. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Note: Personal data: the API serves officials' and coaches' emails, phones and home towns, and clubs' bank accounts and addresses, publicly. The parsers never output them (officials appear by name only; club addresses, personnel and the commissioner report are dropped). Do not add them back. Note: Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/2027); KZS' own season ids are opaque (27 = 2026/2027) and the runtime maps them. Competition ids are per season. Three team keys are never interchangeable: the match-team id (per match and side), team_id (one club team in one season) and club_id (across seasons). player_id is the registry id, person_id the person behind it. Note: Errors are HTTP 400 for everything (an unknown id and a bad parameter alike), so the runtime raises ValueError for it, never an empty frame. List routes default to 150 rows with no truncation signal: every list wrapper asks for a large limit and refuses a full page. The play-by-play and box-score wrappers, the leaderboards, teams, rounds and playing days each make one extra, cached request (the match header or the competition) to prove the answer is the one asked for and the game is final. Note: Coverage: scores from 2007/08; box scores and play-by-play from 2015/16. Some 2020/21 men's games have a box score but no play-by-play (NoDataError): the Genius data.json (genius_match_id in kzs_matches) is the fallback. Shot x/y are Genius court percent; side (LEFT/RIGHT) names the basket end and teams switch ends at half time, so normalise with side before stacking shots. Advanced box-score fields are 0 in every observed game.

documents.t: Every season (39: 1991/1992 to 2029/2030) with its opaque id and the sdv END year. Endpoint URL: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/seasons/ Valid URL: https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/seasons/?limit=1000
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

Competitions of a season (leagues, cups, youth, 3x3, national teams), or of every season. Endpoint URL: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/competitions/ Valid URL: https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/competitions/?limit=10000&season=2026
return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.

return_parsed=True (default) — a tidy polars.DataFrame with the columns below; pass return_as_pandas=True for a pandas.DataFrame. return_parsed=False — the raw JSON Dict payload, unparsed.
